build.release: CubeSteps club edition and human-friendly F2L preview

configuration: Actual built club Lab UI and production worker; first visible candidate has independent main-thread physical validation. Cold = fresh browser profile, warm = same page/cache; each analysis still creates its own worker. Initial page readiness is recorded separately and in endToEndFirstMs. Stop measures click dispatch to actual worker.terminate, not only UI state.

environment.backgroundActivity: One serial WebKit regression suite on the same desktop; not an idle-host measurement.
